description: Election Commission - Declare that P. N. Jayawardana was elected as the member of the 21-Ethanawaththa of Wariyapola Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government authority (Wariyapola Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local government positions, including the declaration of an elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a party membership cessation. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for government bodies.
